methodology: Algolia items API fetch (1170 nodes incl. story; 1169 live comments, 0 dead/deleted). Pass 1: 6 round-robin chunks of ~195 comments, 6 parallel worker classifiers, dual-listing allowed; 485 flags (100% ID-validated against JSONL). Pass 2 (insider propagation): two regex disclosure scans found zero true self-identified FAA/airline/ATC insiders (1 false positive); worker-applied first_hand_aviation/domain_expertise signals (41 comments) covered what propagation would add. Pass 3 recall: re-read 40 unflagged comments from 18 high-value authors, 16 additions (10 signal, 6 author-jokes to noise). Pass 4 (cross-thread repeat-offender) skipped: not a launch thread. Enrichment: 28 author profiles fetched from HN user pages (1.1s spacing, 0 nulls after retry); account_age_days_at_comment computed from profile front?day= dates. Patterns are rhetorical, never proof of botting.
